item.title: Felixdorf
item.description: Due to damage on the track, trains can only run to a limited extent at Felixdorf station at present. There are occasional train cancellations and delays of up to 10 minutes. [Since 00:05]
item.content:encoded:
Due to damage on the track, trains can only run to a limited extent at Felixdorf station at present. There are occasional train cancellations and delays of up to 10 minutes.
[Since 00:05]
